purpose: Required input contract for E6b paired Development generation; this file is not an experimental result or a model input.
requirements: Every retrieval-required active Development v3 task has one ranked hydrated candidate list from a single frozen run. The trace records actually indexed dense-vector counts per mounted source, and each task must return exactly min(40, indexed vectors across its allowed sources); lexical-only projections do not enter this denominator. Raw top-8 is control. Candidate starts from raw top-8 and reserves at most six distinct publisher identity groups using exact or stable English-prefix token overlap between the model-visible request and source-owned identity labels. It does not consult the task target source, evaluator gold, assertions or answers. Explicit no-retrieval tasks retain empty contexts in both arms and do not enter the selector-change denominator.

Each selected chunk retains non-empty evidence text, a source/page-bound citation ID, source version, page and retrieval-text SHA-256. A verified evaluator anchor may be used when it exactly matches, otherwise the producer emits retrieved:<chunkId>; the exporter verifies that fallback ID, page and text digest against its candidate metadata, verifies declared evaluator anchors against frozen ground truth, and requires visual/OCR evidence to retain an in-root artifact path and SHA-256.

Declared multimodal tasks require a verified source-matching visual/OCR artifact in the candidate arm; the selector does not target or infer that source, and a missing control artifact remains a measured baseline failure. Controlled short-document hydration covers every locally detected visual page within a 12-page and three-regions-per-page ceiling. The trace records retrieval run ID, Git commit and corpus-lock SHA-256; the CLI verifies that hash against the supplied frozen corpus lock and rejects task gaps, out-of-scope sources, malformed artifacts, incomplete candidate evidence and a changed-task rate below 20%.

A live Pinecone query that returns an empty list for a non-empty scoped projection is retried with bounded exponential backoff. Exhaustion fails the producer and triggers vector cleanup instead of emitting an incomplete trace.

Publisher-owned source/page artifact lookup covers every active Development multimodal source and binds each emitted image to its frozen in-repository path and SHA-256; missing or mismatched artifacts fail closed.
Only after the exporter has produced paired contexts may prompts, a model request manifest and E6b/E7 Development calls be frozen.
